name: olorin-browser-extension
description: Olorin printing extension for Chrome and Firefox — silent receipt/label printing for web apps like the Koha ILS via the Olorin Companion App
author: Kyle M Hall

scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts e2e && prettier --check .
scripts.start:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run lint:firefox
